intro: You did not understand today's lesson. Ask your teacher for help.

conversation.speaker: teacher
conversation.text: You look worried. Is everything all right?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Tell the teacher you did not understand the lesson.
expected: I did not understand the lesson.
I did not understand today's lesson.
Sorry, I did not understand it.
conversation.hint: Try: "I did not understand the lesson."

conversation.speaker: teacher
conversation.text: That is fine. Which part was difficult?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say which part was difficult for you.
expected: The second part was difficult for me.

conversation.speaker: teacher
conversation.text: Would you like me to explain it again?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Politely ask the teacher to explain it again.
expected: Yes, could you explain it again please?
Yes please, could you explain it again?
conversation.hint: Try: "Yes, could you explain it again please?"

conversation.speaker: teacher
conversation.text: Of course. Come to my desk after the bell.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Ask what time you should come.
expected: At what time shall I come?

conversation.speaker: teacher
conversation.text: Come at four o'clock. I will be here.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Thank the teacher for helping you.
expected: Thank you, I will come at four.
